data_fields.name: spriteTextureFree
data_fields.donor_constant: every frame texture and the atlas texture

best_idea: A timed sweep of unused decoded assets that releases GPU handles in small idle slices, with a holder count so an entity that still draws from an asset cannot have its texture freed under it.
decision_why: The timed, idle-sliced eviction fits our zone and actor art loading, but Frankendom needs explicit retain and release holds and must not port the global mutable map or the unguarded removal.
acceptance: An asset read at t = 29 s survives the t = 30 s sweep; an asset held by a live creature or effect is never freed during a 60 s fight; a half-loaded asset is never removed; a unit test asserts at most 5 assets are freed per idle slice.
